risk_description:
The wheel hubs may not be sufficiently tightened to the rear axle, which may cause a wheel to detach from the rear suspension crossbar. 
This could result in a loss of control over the vehicle, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements set out in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
